name: set_mempolicy
synopsis: long set_mempolicy(int mode, const unsigned long *nodemask, unsigned long maxnode);
description: Sets the NUMA memory policy for the calling thread, specifying how memory is allocated from particular nodes on a NUMA system. This policy governs page allocations in the process's address space, affecting anonymous memory and memory-mapped files.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Specifies the memory policy mode, such as MPOL_DEFAULT, MPOL_BIND, MPOL_INTERLEAVE, MPOL_PREFERRED, or MPOL_LOCAL, and may include optional flags like MPOL_F_NUMA_BALANCING

parameters.name: nodemask
parameters.description: Pointer to a bitmask of node IDs that the policy applies to

parameters.name: maxnode
parameters.description: The maximum node number, indicating the size of the nodemask; a value of zero specifies an empty set

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Part of the memory range specified by nodemask and maxnode is outside the accessible address space
Invalid mode, empty nodemask when required, or other invalid arguments such as unsupported flags
